works.title: OtMartina Christmas Box
works.cardAlt: Christmas gift box and festive sticker collection designed for OtMartina.
works.subtitle: A festive packaging system designed to transform holiday confectionery into a memorable gifting experience.
works.brandStory: OtMartina celebrates the magic of the holiday season through joyful design, playful storytelling, and memorable gifting experiences. The Christmas Box was created to strengthen the brand's festive identity by combining vibrant seasonal colors, custom illustrations, expressive typography, and charming holiday details into one cohesive visual system. From the gift box to the collectible sticker series, every element was designed to spark excitement, create emotional connection, and make each product feel like a gift before it is even opened. The result is a distinctive holiday packaging experience that captures the warmth of Christmas while reinforcing OtMartina as a fun, recognizable, and family-oriented confectionery brand.

works.title: OT MARTINA POP CORN
works.cardAlt: Colorful popcorn packaging design for the OtMartina brand.
works.subtitle: A vibrant popcorn packaging system inspired by the magic of every pop.
works.brandStory:
Popcorn is more than a snack - it's a moment of excitement. This packaging was designed to capture the magical transformation that happens when every kernel bursts into life, turning an everyday product into a playful visual experience.
The identity combines vibrant colors, floating popcorn illustrations, and a charismatic brand mascot to create a package that immediately stands out on the shelf. Every design element reinforces energy, fun, and the anticipation of the next pop.
A flexible visual system was developed across multiple flavors, maintaining strong brand recognition while allowing each product to express its own personality through color and illustration.
The result is a bold and memorable packaging system that transforms a simple snack into a recognizable brand with high shelf impact and a modern, engaging presence across retail and digital platforms.

works.title: GAUDÉLY
works.cardAlt: Luxury brand identity system for GAUDÉLY featuring logo design, typography, packaging, and social media assets.
works.subtitle: Elegant branding designed to communicate authenticity, trust, and timeless sophistication.
works.brandStory:
GAUDÉLY was created as a premium reseller brand focused on authentic watches and carefully selected luxury accessories. The goal was to build an identity that communicates trust, exclusivity, and timeless elegance while remaining modern and recognizable across every customer touchpoint.
The visual identity is centered around sophisticated typography and a distinctive symbolic "G", creating a memorable mark that reflects precision, heritage, and refined taste. A deep burgundy color palette reinforces the brand's premium positioning, while clean layouts and generous white space emphasize clarity and confidence.
Beyond the logo, the identity extends into packaging, printed materials, social media, and digital communication, forming a consistent visual language that strengthens recognition across every platform.
The result is a complete branding system that elevates the shopping experience, positioning GAUDÉLY as a trusted destination for original luxury products with a modern and elegant presence.

works.title: CHOCOLATE PALACE
works.cardAlt: Premium chocolate packaging collection featuring fruit, nuts, and Belgian chocolate in colorful metallic wrappers.
works.subtitle: Premium confectionery packaging inspired by natural ingredients and handcrafted Belgian chocolate.
works.brandStory:
Chocolate Palace was created as a premium confectionery brand that celebrates the harmony of fine Belgian chocolate, carefully selected nuts, and naturally dried fruits. The objective was to design a visual identity that immediately communicates quality, craftsmanship, and indulgence.
The packaging system is built around a distinctive ingredient illustration that reveals the product's filling at first glance, creating both transparency and strong shelf recognition. Each flavor is assigned its own metallic color palette, allowing the collection to remain visually unified while making every variety easy to identify.
Elegant typography, refined layouts, and premium finishing details reinforce the artisanal character of the brand. From individual wrapped chocolates to gift boxes and presentation materials, every touchpoint follows the same sophisticated visual language.
The result is a complete packaging identity that elevates the product into a premium gifting experience while building a memorable and recognizable confectionery brand.

works.title: HAR ENERGY
works.cardAlt: Modern energy drink can packaging featuring a bold H-shaped identity across multiple flavors.
works.subtitle: A vibrant packaging system inspired by the different forms of energy.
works.brandStory:
This project explores how different forms of energy can be translated into a bold and memorable visual identity. Each flavor represents a unique type of energy from ice and fire to power, wildness, and vibrant fruit expressed through distinctive colors and atmospheric textures.
At the heart of the design is a large symbolic "H", transforming the brand's initial into a dynamic graphic element that instantly captures attention. Combined with clean typography and a modern can layout, the identity creates a strong shelf presence while remaining highly recognizable across the entire product range.
Every flavor is built around its own visual atmosphere without losing the consistency of the brand system. The result is a flexible packaging family that communicates movement, strength, and personality, delivering a modern energy drink experience that stands apart from conventional competitors.

works.title: Dr. Diana
works.cardAlt: Personal brand identity for a plastic surgeon featuring elegant typography, stationery, color palette, and premium medical branding.
works.subtitle: A refined visual identity designed for a multidisciplinary plastic surgeon focused on trust, precision, and patient care.
works.brandStory:
Dr. Diana is a multidisciplinary plastic surgeon whose practice combines medical precision with aesthetic excellence. The objective was to create a visual identity that communicates trust, professionalism, and calm confidence while reflecting the premium standard of modern medical care.
The identity is built around a minimalist monogram inspired by precision and balance. Soft neutral tones, refined typography, and generous white space create a clean and reassuring visual language that reflects safety, expertise, and attention to detail.
Every element from printed materials and consultation documents to digital communication and brand visuals—was designed to deliver a consistent patient experience. The branding emphasizes clarity and elegance, allowing the medical expertise to remain at the center of every interaction.
The result is a timeless healthcare identity that strengthens credibility, builds patient trust, and positions Dr. Diana's practice with a modern, sophisticated, and highly recognizable presence.
